excerpts: OpenRouter charges a 5.5% ($0.80 minimum) fee when you purchase credits.
We pass through the pricing of the underlying model providers without any markup
Spend alert | Sends a notification; API traffic continues
Hard spend limit | Affected API requests return a `429` error
Reaching a project hard limit returns a `429` error with the `project_spend_limit_exceeded` code.
Enforcement is not instantaneous. The API Platform can process a small amount of extra usage while the limit state propagates, so recorded spend can slightly exceed the configured amount.

Setting a monthly spend limit allows you to establish soft spending thresholds for your project. When usage exceeds this limit within a given calendar month (UTC), API requests will continue to be processed without interruption.

A spend limit can monitor spend without enforcement, or you can enforce it as a hard limit so API requests fail after spend reaches the limit. For the latest configuration steps and behavior, see Spend limits in the developer documentation.
sources.caveat: The same help page carries both the older soft-only wording and the newer enforce-as-hard-limit wording. Treated as: a project limit is alert-only unless 'Enforce a hard limit' is switched on (per OA-SPEND-LIMITS).
